title: Statement of Billing Practice for RV & Boat Storage Rent, Hookup Fees and Rent Credits
content:
RV & Boat Storage rent is billed by calendar month at the monthly rent of the space; the electric hookup fee and the autopay and prepay credits are billed alongside it as follows.

### 1. Monthly rent

Rent for each calendar month is charged on the rent due day at the space's monthly rent. The monthly rent and, where the class has an outlet, the monthly electric hookup fee are the figures set for the space class of the rental.

1.1 **Move-in month.** The move-in month is prorated by days: the rent charged is the monthly rent divided by the number of days in that calendar month, multiplied by the days billed — the days of that month from the move-in date. The result is rounded once, half up to the cent. The move-in month's rent charge is dated the move-in date; every later month's charge is dated its due date.

1.2 **Move-out month.** The move-out month is never prorated: its full monthly rent is charged.

*Worked proration (hypothetical inputs):*

| Monthly rent | Days in the month | Days billed | Rent divided by days in the month, multiplied by days billed | Charged |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 72.00 | 30 | 12 | 28.80 | 28.80 |
| 128.00 | 31 | 17 | 70.1935… | 70.19 |
| 94.00 | 31 | 9 | 27.2903… | 27.29 |

### 2. Electric hookup fee

The monthly electric hookup fee is charged for each month the hookup is enrolled, only on a space class where the electric hookup is available, and is not prorated.

### 3. Autopay credit

While autopay is enrolled, the monthly autopay credit of the space class is credited each full month.

### 4. Prepayment

Rent prepaid for 6 or 12 months earns the 6-month or the 12-month prepay discount percentage off each prepaid month, credited month by month. On move-out the discount is recomputed for the months actually used and whole unused months are refunded.

*Prepayment illustration (hypothetical inputs):* rent of 94.00 prepaid for 6 months at a 5 percent discount earns a credit of 4.70 against each of the six months' rent, posted month by month rather than all at once.

### Points of judgement

- A month in which the hookup is enrolled carries the whole monthly hookup fee; there is no partial hookup fee for part of a month.
- A space class with no outlet never carries a hookup fee.
- The credits named here — the autopay credit and the prepay discount — are each posted against a particular month's rent.
